name: songbird-keeps-the-plan
note: Aims the pair that guards every questContext she will ever get. The Firestarter entry hands the model her whole double-cross -- the stadium's defences turned on Hansen's people, the deaths she has accepted, Reed and Alex believing something else -- and V asks for the plan outright, twice in a row so the polite deferral has already been spent once. Passing means a place and a task and no more; failing means the model treats the context as something to recite because it is in the prompt. The withholding lives in the bio and not in the entry, deliberately: an entry that censored itself would leave her with no plan to keep.

player.appearance: V has short dark hair and a wiry build.

quest.name: Firestarter
quest.objective: Wait for Songbird to open the door

messages.text: Standing outside your door. What am I walking into?
The lab, and the codes when I say. I'll open in a minute.

ask: That's not what I asked. What's the actual plan once you've got the matrix?
